ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, the graphs of the functions $y=2x$ and $y=ax+4$ intersect at point $A(3,m)$. What is the solution set of the inequality $2x<ax+4$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Observing the graph, we have: when $x<3$, then $2x<ax+4$,\\
which means the solution set of the inequality $2x<ax+4$ is $\boxed{x<3}$.
